features.label: Renounced his own masterpieces
features.detail: Late in life dismissed the great novels as vanity. He would have disliked why you are reading him.

features.label: An aristocrat trying to stop being one
features.detail: Gave away property, dressed as a peasant, and failed at it publicly for decades.

features.label: Died fleeing his own home
features.detail: Left at eighty-two and died at a railway station. The last act is a philosophy failing in real time.
